description: Get full detail for a single open-access PLOS article by DOI, including title, journal, publication date, authors, abstract, and subject tags. Data: api.plos.org, no auth required.

doi.description: Article DOI, e.g. "10.1371/journal.pone.0004050" (returned as "doi" in plos-search.search results).

name: plos-search.article.detail

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get PLOS Article Detail
